title: Read the top cards
text: Total Sales is collected money after change and refunds. Net Profit is sales minus product costs and expenses. Cancelled sales are not included.
steps: Click Sidebar > Dashboard.
Point to a card's info icon to see what it includes.
The arrow compares the card with the previous period.
Expenses come from the Expenses page. COGS means product cost.
Click Low Stock, No Stock, Near Expiry, or Expired to open that inventory list.

title: Change the dashboard period
text: Choose a period for all dashboard cards and charts. The default is the last 7 days.
steps: Click Sidebar > Dashboard.
Click Date Period and choose a preset or custom date range.
Click Clear to view all time.
Use the arrows on the monthly chart to change years.
Click Refresh to show the latest sales.

title: Charts and top product lists
text: The dashboard shows sales by day, hour, and payment method. Product lists show the top products.
steps: Click Sidebar > Dashboard.
Change the number beside a list to show more or fewer products.
Turn on Hide 0-sale days to hide days when the store was closed.
Click View full report to open the full report in Reporting.

title: Payables and receivables
text: Payables is what you owe suppliers. Receivables is what customers owe you. The dashboard groups these balances by age: current, 31-60, 61-90, and over 90 days.
steps: Click Sidebar > Dashboard.
Switch between the Payables and Receivables tabs.
Click View Payables to open Suppliers.
Click View Receivables to open Customers.

title: Print the dashboard
text: Print the dashboard as a PDF.
steps: Click Sidebar > Dashboard.
Choose the period to print.
On a computer, click Print Dashboard.
In the preview, print or download the PDF.

title: Getting Started checklist
text: The Getting Started checklist shows the setup tasks for your store. Tasks are checked off as you complete them.
steps: Click Sidebar > Dashboard.
Click the Getting Started checklist at the top right.
Click Start on a task to open its setup page.
Click Skip on the printer task if you do not need it.
Click X to hide the checklist. To start over, click Settings > Reset before going live.

title: All-branch dashboard
text: Use All Branch to see sales and performance for every branch in one dashboard.
steps: Owners: click the branch name at the top and choose All Branch.
Click Dashboard in the sidebar.
Review the Branch Performance table and Top Selling Categories.
Use Quick Actions to add a branch, transfer stock, or open a report.
Choose one branch again to return to its full dashboard.
